data.why: The app has no upload widget, only a server-side TextInput for an absolute local .nc path, and no binary file can be authored directly by this tool, so a tiny script (placed at /work/app/make_sample.py by the seed step) generates a small lat/lon/time NetCDF with xarray during install, matching the app's expected schema.

goals: Load a NetCDF file by path and inspect its variables, dimensions, and metadata
Visualize the spatial distribution of a variable on an interactive heatmap with an appropriate colormap and color scale
Click a grid cell or drag a box to extract a timeseries and its anomalies, with trend lines (OLS or Theil-Sen) and a Savitzky-Golay smoothed curve
Check the annual cycle (monthly climatology) of a variable as a bar plot
Animate or step through time to see how the spatial pattern evolves
Compare area-averaged versus single-point timeseries and judge whether a trend is robust

review.summary: The tree captures what Aether is for: loading a NetCDF file, mapping a variable through time, and pulling point or area timeseries with anomalies, smoothing and OLS/Theil-Sen trends, and every screen I sampled supports its node. It needs a rerun of the check (the checker used the wrong file path), removal of the failed axis-swap task, and a cleaner cut of the features: separate the latitude profile, annual cycle and loader/dimension picker, and split metadata from notes.
